poses.name: Mid-walk (auto anchor)
poses.prompt: Mid-stride walking pose in strict side view profile, facing the SAME direction as the reference image: the character is caught in the middle of a step — front leg forward with the knee in natural walking flexion, back leg extended behind, opposite-arm swing in a moderate arc, torso leaning slightly forward into the motion. Visibly IN MOTION, NOT standing. All ground-contact points on the same horizontal baseline. Same character, same colors, same art style, same side-view camera. BODY MASS LOCK: the character's body build is IDENTICAL to the reference image — same body mass, same bulk, same shoulder and torso width, same limb thickness, same muscle and armor volume, same head-to-body ratio. A pose only bends and repositions limbs; it never changes the body itself. The requested pose may become narrower only through natural overlap or foreshortening of unchanged anatomy, never by redrawing the head, facial features, shoulders, torso, or limbs narrower. Do NOT render the character thinner, slimmer, smaller, more elongated, more athletic, or more delicate than the reference. PROPS LOCK: the character carries EXACTLY what the reference image shows — an object held or carried in the reference stays held, same object, same hand, unchanged; if the hands are empty in the reference they stay empty. Never add, swap, or redraw any object. An arm that is carrying something keeps its natural carrying pose instead of swinging.
